fusions.name: Palmed Blade
fusions.desc: Flicks a palmed blade that deals 7 damage, with 50% more critical chance against an enemy that is not yet wounded. It holds 3 charges, and every kill you make gives one back.

fusions.name: Skinning Cut
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 18 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds, and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Under the Guard
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Skinner's Eye
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
